say:1:1710611001:1.text: What are you two sneaking around for, hmm?
say:1:1710611001:1.source_cn: 喂，你们两个，鬼鬼祟祟地在这里在干什么呢？

choice_prompt:2:1710611001.text: What are you two sneaking around for, hmm?
choice_prompt:2:1710611001.source_cn: 喂，你们两个，鬼鬼祟祟地在这里在干什么呢？

say:3:1710611002:1.text: Oh... I looked all day yesterday. No luck. So I thought I'd try a new spot...
say:3:1710611002:1.source_cn: 唔……昨天转了整整一天没有结果，所以今天来了其他地方……
say:3:1710611002:1.male: Oh... I looked all day yesterday. No luck. So I thought I'd try a new spot...
say:3:1710611002:1.female: Oh... I looked all day yesterday. No luck. So I thought I'd try a new spot...

say:4:1710611003:1.text: Hey, no! Don't turn this around! I'm asking the questions!
say:4:1710611003:1.source_cn: 不对不对，又被你带偏了！这话应该我问你们！
say:4:1710611003:1.male: Hey, no! Don't turn this around! I'm asking the questions!
say:4:1710611003:1.female: Hey, no! Don't turn this around! I'm asking the questions!

say:5:1710611004:1.text: Weren't you tracking the Solitaries? Why are you here with Gwyneth?
say:5:1710611004:1.source_cn: 你不是在找隐士调查线索吗？怎么来猎场玩了，还带着格温妮丝。
say:5:1710611004:1.male: Weren't you tracking the Solitaries? Why are you here with Gwyneth?
say:5:1710611004:1.female: Weren't you tracking the Solitaries? Why are you here with Gwyneth?

say:6:1710611005:1.text: You explain the "wings" symbol and the Prince's falcons at the hunting grounds.
say:6:1710611005:1.source_cn: 你告诉小狐狸，翅膀这一线索与王子在狮心猎场中秘密豢养的...
say:6:1710611005:1.male: You explain the "wings" symbol and the Prince's falcons at the hunting grounds.
say:6:1710611005:1.female: You explain the "wings" symbol and the Prince's falcons at the hunting grounds.

say:7:1710611006:1.text: ... Interesting. Falcons, huh? Those winged thieves love stealing a fox's hard work.
say:7:1710611006:1.source_cn: ……有意思。鹰啊，那些长着翅膀的家伙，它们会和狐狸抢猎物呢。
say:7:1710611006:1.male: ... Interesting. Falcons, huh? Those winged thieves love stealing a fox's hard work.
say:7:1710611006:1.female: ... Interesting. Falcons, huh? Those winged thieves love stealing a fox's hard work.

say:8:1710611007:1.text: You're not thinking of sneaking in, are you?
say:8:1710611007:1.source_cn: 你们该不会是想溜进猎场吧？

choice_prompt:9:1710611007.text: You're not thinking of sneaking in, are you?
choice_prompt:9:1710611007.source_cn: 你们该不会是想溜进猎场吧？

say:10:1710611008:1.text: Ahem! Lucky for you, this fox happens to know a secret passage no one ever notices!
say:10:1710611008:1.source_cn: 咳咳，本狐知道一条绝对不会被人发现的秘密通道！
say:10:1710611008:1.male: Ahem! Lucky for you, this fox happens to know a secret passage no one ever notices!
say:10:1710611008:1.female: Ahem! Lucky for you, this fox happens to know a secret passage no one ever notices!

say:12:1710611009:1.text: Wait, how do you know a secret path into the hunting grounds?
say:12:1710611009:1.source_cn: 等等！小狐狸，你为什么会知道猎场的秘密通道？

say:13:1710611010:1.text: I told you! I was the first king's favorite pet!
say:13:1710611010:1.source_cn: 我之前告诉过你们呀！我是某位国王的爱宠！

say:15:1710611011:1.text: He adored me. Hunts, feasts—if he went, I went too!
say:15:1710611011:1.source_cn: 他可喜欢我了！他当年打猎、宴会，甚至巡视军务都离不开我...

choice_prompt:16:1710611011.text: He adored me. Hunts, feasts—if he went, I went too!
choice_prompt:16:1710611011.source_cn: 他可喜欢我了！他当年打猎、宴会，甚至巡视军务都离不开我，非要带着我！

say:17:1710611012:1.text: Shh! Magister, don't ruin the mystery! Pick whichever story you like best.
say:17:1710611012:1.source_cn: 嘘——大魔法师，不能当面拆穿狐狸！狐狸说话固然有真有假...
say:17:1710611012:1.male: Shh! Magister, don't ruin the mystery! Pick whichever story you like best.
say:17:1710611012:1.female: Shh! Magister, don't ruin the mystery! Pick whichever story you like best.

say:18:1710611013:1.text: You look at the cunning fox and sigh. He always hides an unbelievable truth behind an even wilder lie.
say:18:1710611013:1.source_cn: 你无奈地看着这只狡猾的狐狸。他总是用最夸张的谎言来掩盖...
say:18:1710611013:1.male: You look at the cunning fox and sigh. He always hides an unbelievable truth behind an even wilder lie.
say:18:1710611013:1.female: You look at the cunning fox and sigh. He always hides an unbelievable truth behind an even wilder lie.

say:19:1710611014:1.text: But right now, you need his help.
say:19:1710611014:1.source_cn: 但无论如何，眼下他的帮助是你们最需要的。
say:19:1710611014:1.male: But right now, you need his help.
say:19:1710611014:1.female: But right now, you need his help.

choice_prompt:20:1710611014.text: But right now, you need his help.
choice_prompt:20:1710611014.source_cn: 但无论如何，眼下他的帮助是你们最需要的。
choice_prompt:20:1710611014.male: But right now, you need his help.
choice_prompt:20:1710611014.female: But right now, you need his help.

say:21:1710611015:1.text: Good! But you'll need a trick to use the passage. Lucky for you, one of you is a mage.
say:21:1710611015:1.source_cn: 这就对了！不过嘛……你们走那条通道的话要想想特殊办法，...
say:21:1710611015:1.male: Good! But you'll need a trick to use the passage. Lucky for you, one of you is a mage.
say:21:1710611015:1.female: Good! But you'll need a trick to use the passage. Lucky for you, one of you is a mage.

choice:20:0:1.text: ... Fine, I'll trust you this time.
choice:20:0:1.male: ... Fine, I'll trust you this time.
choice:20:0:1.female: ... Fine, I'll trust you this time.

choice:20:1:2.text: At least you were honest about the scabbard.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 剑鞘那次你倒是也没骗人……
choice:20:1:2.male: At least you were honest about the scabbard.
choice:20:1:2.female: At least you were honest about the scabbard.

choice:16:0:1.text: You said that story was fake.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 你明明说过那是假故事
choice:16:0:1.male: You said that story was fake.
choice:16:0:1.female: You said that story was fake.

choice:16:1:2.text: You also said you were a cursed prince.
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 你还说过自己是被诅咒的王子
choice:16:1:2.male: You also said you were a cursed prince.
choice:16:1:2.female: You also said you were a cursed prince.

choice:2:0:1.text: How did you end up here?
choice:2:0:1.male: How did you end up here?
choice:2:0:1.female: How did you end up here?

choice:2:1:2.text: Shouldn't you be looking for the sword?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你不应该在找石中剑吗
choice:2:1:2.male: Shouldn't you be looking for the sword?
choice:2:1:2.female: Shouldn't you be looking for the sword?
